all_72_mesh_audit.method: Fresh read of 72 current active STLs from the R1.5 package: 42 primary fit-kit, 21 upper concept, 9 optional outsole study. Raw triangle facets are checked for finiteness; duplicate vertices are welded and duplicate/degenerate faces removed only in in-memory audit copy; source STL bytes are not modified by audit.
limitations: Topology processing is a software interpretation of STL facets; the source STL bytes are not rewritten by this audit. Manufacturing mesh acceptance and slicer/toolpath checks remain separate.
Watertightness and non-zero mesh volume do not establish part strength, tolerance fit or wear safety.

Source changed after original 42/9 export only by comments clarifying that pneumatic relief/regulator-family numeric limits are unverified planning assumptions; no CAD geometry changed.
